Rationale.RP1_ImplementationReconstructability: The experiment can be fully reconstructed from plan.md and CodeWalkthrough.md. The plan clearly describes causal tracing methodology, ROME algorithm, and evaluation metrics. No major guesswork required - all implementation details are documented or visible in source code.
Rationale.RP2_EnvironmentReproducibility: Environment restored successfully with setup_conda.sh script. Required packages (transformers, torch) are standard. Pre-trained GPT-2 XL available from HuggingFace. Cached statistics provided. No external API keys required for core experiments.
Rationale.RP3_DeterminismAndStability: Results are stable and reproducible. Random seeds explicitly set in causal tracing (numpy.random.RandomState(1)). ROME optimization consistently converges to >98% probability. Evaluation metrics are deterministic. Minor variance in peak layer (±1-2) is within acceptable bounds.
Rationale.RP4_DemoPresentation: Repository provides comprehensive demos: notebooks/causal_trace.ipynb and notebooks/rome.ipynb. Both are executable without external materials, cover main experiments, include clear explanations, and produce results matching the paper.
